configurePresets.name: windows-msvc-ninja
configurePresets.description: Shared settings for the everyday Windows builds: Ninja with MSVC, so every source compiles in parallel. Visual Studio's Open Folder mode supplies the compiler environment; from a shell, use a Developer PowerShell for VS 2022.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Everyday Windows build: Debug with the editor, developer tools, and Vulkan validation.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimized Windows build of the game and tests. The editor, developer tools, and validation exist only in Debug builds; use the shipping presets for player packages.

configurePresets.name: headless-tests
configurePresets.description: Vulkan-free Debug build of the core, UI, and every SDK-independent test. Builds no game.

configurePresets.name: shipping
configurePresets.description: Editor-free Release build with LTO and a separate PDB symbols package.

configurePresets.name: shipping-installer
configurePresets.description: Editor-free Release installer. Requires Inno Setup 6.

configurePresets.name: shipping-signed
configurePresets.description: Installer with verified Authenticode signatures. Requires Inno Setup, signtool, and a certificate thumbprint.

buildPresets.name: dev
buildPresets.description: Builds the game, its content, and nothing else: the inner loop.

buildPresets.name: dev-all
buildPresets.description: The game and every test runner the dev test preset uses.

buildPresets.name: release
buildPresets.description: An optimized game and its content, without the editor.

buildPresets.name: release-all
buildPresets.description: The optimized game and every test runner the release test preset uses.

buildPresets.name: headless-tests
buildPresets.description: Only the Vulkan-independent test suites, as the SDK-free CI job builds them. There is no game in this build.

buildPresets.name: shipping
buildPresets.description: Editor-free Release game with LTO; package it with cpack --preset shipping.

buildPresets.name: shipping-installer
buildPresets.description: The per-user Windows installer. Requires Inno Setup 6.

buildPresets.name: shipping-signed
buildPresets.description: The installer with verified Authenticode signatures. Requires a signing certificate.
